title: SkyrimNet Dialogue Scenario Editor
tagline: Write scenarios that nearby NPCs play out - narration, lines spoken in their own voice, OStim scenes - or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you with SkyrimNet's AI.
description:
**For adult players.** Scenarios can end in sex scenes (OStim).

Write short scenarios that real NPCs play out when you meet them: who takes part, what the situation is, who says what, and how each part ends. Or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you. SkyrimNet's AI speaks every line in the speaker's own voice, so the same scenario fits any character.

## Scenarios in columns
A scenario has up to 10 columns, played from left to right. Each column has 1 to 3 people (the player too), a narration that sets the situation, up to 10 lines in any order (anyone may speak several times), and what ends the column: nothing (talk only), an OStim scene with the tags you pick, or move and wait (chosen people walk to an interior and wait there until another scenario has happened or some days have passed). The same person may appear in several columns; a column with one person can be a masturbation scene.

## Lines in the speaker's own voice
A line is not read out word for word: SkyrimNet is told that the speaker is about to say something that means it, and the AI words it the way that character would. Your own lines are spoken by your character through SkyrimNet.

## Auto lines
Switch a single line to Auto, or a whole column (Short 3, Medium 6, Long 10 lines): the AI makes those lines up when they are spoken, from the column's narration, the columns before and after, and the talk so far.

## Generate
Pick a scenario writer (an NPC), 2 to 10 people (NPCs and you), the number of columns and, if you like, a theme. The writer writes every column in their own style: the people of each column, the narration, the lines with their speakers, and where an OStim scene fits, with tags. It draws on the people's bios, memories, recent events and latest diary entries, and on the relationship maps of SN Sexual Memories when there are any. The result goes into the editor, where you check it, change what you like and save. Generate (auto lines) writes only the people, narration and OStim (tags) of each column and leaves the lines to Auto (Medium). Its model is set in the dashboard: AI > Models, dialogue_scenario_writer (left empty, the default model is used). One request for the plot, then one per column.

## When it starts
Automatically when everyone in it is near you, or when you press the scenario hotkey (set in the MCM), your choice per scenario. You also choose whether others may be around or only the people in it; indoors, outdoors or anywhere, or only in one cell (an interior from the list, or the cell you are in); once or again every few days; and whether another scenario must have finished first.

## How a column plays
The people walk over to you and stay together while they talk; anyone who does not arrive within a few seconds is moved over. Then the column's end (OStim scene, or move and wait) follows and the next column begins at once.

## Settings page
Made and changed on an in-game page (Magelight UI or Prisma UI), opened with a key you set in the MCM. Scenarios are saved as files, the same for every save; whether one has already happened is kept in the save.

## When something goes wrong
The mod writes what it does to SKSE\SkyrimNet_DialogueScenarioEditor.log in Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition: why a scenario is not starting, and while one runs, every line and SkyrimNet's speech events. It is made new at every game start.

## Requirements
SKSE64, Address Library, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, OStim Standalone, PapyrusUtil SE, powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, MCM Helper, SkyUI, and Magelight UI or Prisma UI for the settings page. SN Sexual Memories is optional. It adds no prompt that replaces one of SkyrimNet's own.

## Known limits
Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with Magelight UI; the Prisma UI page has not been tested in game yet. An NPC sitting in a chair may not stand up to walk over and is moved over instead. The installer offers the settings menu and page in English or Japanese.

changelog:
New
- How a column ends is now a choice: nothing (talk only), an OStim scene, or move and wait: chosen people walk to an interior and wait there until another scenario has happened or some days have passed.
- Prerequisite: a scenario can wait until another one has finished.
- Starts by hotkey: each scenario starts automatically or when you press the new MCM key "Key that starts a hotkey scenario".
- Cell condition: a scenario can be limited to one cell, picked from the list of interiors or set to the cell you are in.
- Generate (auto lines): writes only the people, narration and OStim (tags) of each column; the lines are set to Auto (Medium) and made up in the game.
- Log file: Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\SkyrimNet_DialogueScenarioEditor.log, no INI setting needed. It says why a scenario does not start, and while one runs, every line, SkyrimNet's speech events and how long each wait took.

Changed
- A child nearby no longer keeps a scenario from starting (children still cannot take part).

Fixed
- A deleted scenario (also the bundled example) came back after the mod was reinstalled or updated.
- A scenario deleted and made again under the same name counted as having run already.
